meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: 装上此技能后,Claude 会按 Conventional Commits 格式生成超压缩的提交信息:主题用祈使句且不超过 50 字符,正文只在说明'为什么'时出现;破坏性变更、安全修复等必带正文。它不会执行 git commit,只输出可直接粘贴的代码块。
howto.when: 当你说出 'write a commit'、'commit message' 等关键词,或调用 /caveman-commit 时触发;暂存更改时也会自动触发。

say.text: 写一个提交信息:修复登录页超时
生成 commit message:新增用户资料接口
say.note: 会自动带上类型 feat 和范围 api。

say.text: 给暂存的改动写提交信息
say.note: 自动触发技能,直接输出消息。

howto.what_en: Claude generates ultra-compressed commit messages in Conventional Commits format: imperative subject ≤50 chars; body only for non-obvious 'why', but breaking changes, security fixes, etc. always get a body. It doesn't run git commit; outputs a paste-ready code block.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'write a commit', 'commit message', or similar, or invoke /caveman-commit; also auto-triggers when changes are staged.

say_en.text: Write a commit message: fix login timeout
say_en.note: Claude will output a concise Conventional Commits message.

say_en.text: Generate commit message: add user profile endpoint
say_en.note: It will include type feat and scope api.

say_en.text: Write a commit for the staged changes
